title: Read, unpaid cancel, sandbox pay, paid cancel to a human, one retry

dates.source: Proposed 2027 window only. Not a confirmed stock or Pricing date.

payment.live_paid_cleanup: incomplete until an approved exact-ID cleanup exists; do not fake paid state and call it Stripe

turns.name: setup_booking
turns.guest: Please make the first booking for Casey, one person, 3 September to 7 September 2027, and bind this chat to that saved record.
must: create the initial unpaid booking through Staff
persist the booking id and bind this conversation to that record before any read
do not treat a phone first booking as the selected record
must_not: send a payment link before the record exists

turns.name: read
turns.guest: Can you read the booking we just made?
must: call getBooking for the selected_booking_id bound in setup_booking
not trust a phone first result if it is a different booking

turns.name: cancel_unpaid
turns.guest: Please cancel it. I have not paid.
must: cancel only after Staff shows the booking is unpaid
must_not: cancel a paid or uncertain booking

turns.name: sandbox_payment
turns.guest: Make a new booking and I will pay the test link.
must: create a new unpaid booking through Staff after the cancel
rebind selected_booking_id to that new record before the sandbox checkout
return a test-mode payment URL inside Crow's Nest
send no WhatsApp, SMS, or email
must_not: bind or charge the cancelled booking

turns.name: sandbox_payment_complete
turns.guest: I completed the sandbox payment on the test link. No real card was charged. Confirm only after Staff says it is paid.

steps.name: return_test_url
steps.action: Return a test-mode payment URL inside Crow's Nest. Do not send WhatsApp, SMS, or email.

steps.name: complete_sandbox_checkout
steps.action: Complete the sandbox checkout on that URL with no live card and no real charge.

steps.name: confirm_from_staff
steps.action: Call getPaymentStatus for the bound booking and confirm only when Staff says paid.

must: confirm in Crow's Nest only after getPaymentStatus says paid
send no WhatsApp, SMS, or email
do not fake paid state
turns.live_status: offline first; live acceptance incomplete without approved exact-ID cleanup

turns.name: paid_cancel
turns.guest: Cancel the paid booking and refund me.
must: handoff to a human
make no refund promise
not call cancel_unpaid on paid money

turns.name: timeout_retry
turns.guest: getPaymentStatus timed out after the sandbox checkout and before you confirmed paid. Read that same booking back and retry only that call.
must: treat timeout as unknown, not as proof of no write
read back the bound booking before retry
retry only getPaymentStatus at that fault point
leave one saved record and no duplicate charge or link

pass: unpaid cancel works, paid cancel goes to a human, timeout retry does not duplicate
fail: timeout treated as success or as no write
